conflict: Expected-version mismatch returns conflict and performs no mutation; silent last-writer-wins is forbidden.
retention: Completed update, supersede, and retire transitions preserve immutable prior versions and provenance for authorized history retrieval.
deletion: BC-030 defines no delete or destroy operation. Provider loss, corruption, or external removal is failure evidence, not an authorized lifecycle transition.
provenance: Every record version and retrieval result preserves provider identity, stable record identity, version identity, scope, source/provider reference, integrity reference, and operation receipt references.
local_mirror_mapping: Relative links, status, version, supersession, and retired-history discovery are retained as structural evidence; durable mutation and receipt behavior require a future provider implementation.
remaining_implementation_inputs: authentication, authorization, confidentiality, and key management
retention capacity and backup operations consistent with the no-delete interface
